verdict.rationale: v0's docs mention fine‑tuning details with 'visual controls and live preview' and automatic error‑fixing 'in your code,' implying some in‑builder code interaction, but no evidence explicitly describes a code editor pane where a developer can open and directly edit raw generated source inside the builder UI (editing is otherwise done via GitHub branches/PRs).  Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an in-app code editor/view, hands-on confirmation of manual code editing within the builder, and independent corroboration of this specific workflow.
